actual_scope: A literal-program refinement of the bounded 64-bit Word RAM NTT multiplier: replace each constant-one transform-twiddle macro by two full-state-equivalent instructions and relocate branches.
scope_change_reason: This is a bounded compiler/cost side result with a written simulation proof and exact certificate, not proof-assistant formalization or discharge of a selected framework assumption.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex supplier still binds. This separate bounded arithmetic kernel gains a proved uniform instruction saving; its Word RAM invoice is not the selected recursive paid-rank invoice.
stop_rule: Stop after the first verified unit-twiddle saving; leave every other arithmetic and storage specialization for Open next questions.
evidence: PROOF.md and the generated stdout receipt from verify.py: full macro memory equivalence for all 65,537 residues, nine emitted templates, 36 complete dirty-memory cases, and structural controls.
